entities.summary: Maria Margareta Blom is a Swedish film director, dramatist and screenwriter. She is perhaps best known for the film Dalecarlians from 2004. Blom has written and directed more than ten theatre plays among them Rabarbers, Sårskorpor and Dr. Kokos Kärlekslaboratorium at Stockholm City Theatre and Under hallonbusken at the Royal Dramatic Theatre.
